Noah: who knew YAML could be so musical? :notes:
Asha: last night I accidentally hit 'tab' and my config started playing free jazz
Noah: describe your error in karaoke form
Asha: 'I bumped the semver to 1.2.4 (but with a tab), now servers are out of tune' :microphone:
Mika: CI-bot, any objections to this serenade branch?
CI-bot: mika/serenade: lint failed — YAMLError: found tab character at infra/songs.yml:5
Noah: classic. the tab solo. :guitar:
Asha: others: best silly semver excuse? I'll accept haiku and song titles
Mika: 'Patch Bump in the Key of Tabs' — 5-star commit message
Noah: tiny YAML for posterity:
```yaml
service:
  name: jukebox
  version: "1.2.3"  # attempted 1.2.4 but a tab improvised
  tracks:
    - 'semver blues'
    - 'whitespace waltz'
```
Asha: stickers idea: 'I survived the tab solo (v1.2.4)'
Mika: creating issue #9001 'sticker: tab-solo-v1.2.4'
Noah: end thread — don't sed -i while humming. :headphones:
